patent_title: A kind of preparation of high strength nitrile rubber
emulsifier: composite system of disproportionated rosin acid potassium soap, oleic acid potassium soap and naphthalene sulfonic acid formaldehyde condensation compound sodium salt
polymer_properties: Mooney viscosity MS(1+4)100℃ 40-65, tensile strength ≥ 27MPa, elongation at break ≥ 400%
experimental_notes: Adding a terminator and an anti-aging agent when the reaction conversion rate reaches 70-75%, degassing, condensing, washing and drying
